title: Mitigating Capability Degradation in LLM Self-Improvement via Representation Geometry Regularization
abstract: arXiv:2610.12855v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: On-Policy Self-distillation is a self-improvement paradigm that enables large language models (LLMs) to improve their capabilities by leveraging the same model as both teacher and student under different conditioning contexts. However, we find that OPSD methods can progressively degrade previously acquired capabilities: queries that are correctly responded at earlier training stages may become incorrectly responded as optimization proceeds, even the overall performance continues to improve. Further analysis reveals that this degradation coincides with a deterioration of the geometry of hidden representations, characterized by reduced intra-cluster compactness and diminished inter-cluster separation. Motivated by this observation, we propose Representation Geometry Regularization (RGR), which preserves representation geometry during post-training by encouraging compactness within cluster and separation across cluster. translated_abstract: 在线策略自蒸馏（On-Policy Self-distillation, OPSD）是一种自我改进范式，它使大语言模型（LLM）能够在不同的条件上下文中，将同一模型同时作为教师和学生来提升自身能力。然而，我们发现OPSD方法可能会逐渐退化模型先前已获得的能力：在早期训练阶段能够正确回答的查询，随着优化的进行可能变为回答错误，即使整体性能仍在持续提升。进一步分析表明，这种能力退化与隐藏表示几何结构的恶化同时发生，其特征表现为簇内紧凑度降低和簇间分离度减弱。受此观察启发，我们提出了表示几何正则化（Representation Geometry Regularization, RGR），通过鼓励簇内紧凑性和簇间分离性，在后训练过程中保持表示几何结构。RGR可以无缝地（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文发现在线策略自蒸馏（OPSD）会导致大语言模型已获得能力的逐渐退化，其根源在于隐藏表示几何结构的恶化，并提出表示几何正则化（RGR）方法，通过保持簇内紧凑性和簇间分离性来缓解自我改进过程中的能力退化问题。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that On-Policy Self-distillation (OPSD) progressively degrades previously acquired LLM capabilities due to the deterioration of hidden representation geometry, and proposes Representation Geometry Regularization (RGR), which preserves intra-cluster compactness and inter-cluster separation to mitigate capability degradation during self-improvement.
